S0839.reason: Established active-phase labor (7 cm, regular q4 min) that became weak and infrequent after repeated analgesia is hypotonic uterine dysfunction; Braxton Hicks, Bandl ring, and primary dysfunction do not fit.

S0779.reason: Severance of commonly owned land left the retained parcel landlocked, so an easement by necessity arose for the grantor and passed to the cousin; a neighbor’s offer to sell access and the lack of an express reservation do not defeat it.

S0579.reason: Plywood is fungible and the mill’s own lumber reserve was not a contractually specified exclusive source, so the fire neither makes delivery impossible nor frustrates the contract’s purpose.
